caption: The drawing depicts a cylindrical container with a lid, featuring two handles on opposite sides. The container and lid are rendered in shades of brown and orange, giving a textured and mottled appearance that resembles ceramic or clay. The lid fits snugly on top and has a large looped handle for lifting. The container has a decorated band around its upper section with a scalloped edge motif. The surface of the object shows variations in color, including lighter and darker patches, possibly indicating material texture or shading. The handles are rounded and project outward slightly from the sides. The background is plain and off-white, with some small brown marks scattered across the paper. The container's base is slightly wider than the body, and the overall drawing is centered on the page. There is a small inscription or signature to the right of the object, reading "M.A.R.S." in red-brown ink.
title: Jar
